/*
  * Adds responsive border dividers to .divide grid containers.
  * Targets direct children — no class or tag needed on them.
  *
  * Usage (zero-config):
  *   initCardDividers();
  *
  * Custom options:
  *   initCardDividers('.divide', { color: '#e2e8f0', width: '2px', style: 'dashed' });
  *
  * @param {string} containerSelector  default: '.divide'
  * @param {object} options
  *   color   — default: 'var(--border-general)'
  *   width   — default: '1px'
  *   style   — default: 'solid'
  * 
  * Added by:      @s.n
  * Location:      Bricks > Settings > Custom Code
 **/
  function initCardDividers(containerSelector, options) {
    if (typeof containerSelector === 'object') {
      options = containerSelector;
      containerSelector = '.divide';
    }
    containerSelector = containerSelector || '.divide';
    options = options || {};

    var color = options.color || 'var(--border-general)';
    var width = options.width || '1px';
    var bStyle = options.style || 'solid';
    var border = width + ' ' + bStyle + ' ' + color;

    function getCards(container) {
      return Array.prototype.slice.call(container.children).filter(function (c) {
        return window.getComputedStyle(c).display !== 'none';
      });
    }

    function clearDividers(cards) {
      cards.forEach(function (card) {
        card.style.borderLeft = '';
        card.style.borderBottom = '';
      });
    }

    function groupIntoRows(cards) {
      var rows = [];
      var currentRow = [];
      var currentTop = null;

      cards.forEach(function (card) {
        var top = card.getBoundingClientRect().top;
        if (currentTop === null || Math.abs(top - currentTop) > 2) {
          if (currentRow.length) rows.push(currentRow);
          currentRow = [card];
          currentTop = top;
        } else {
          currentRow.push(card);
        }
      });
      if (currentRow.length) rows.push(currentRow);
      return rows;
    }

    function applyDividers(container) {
      var cards = getCards(container);
      if (!cards.length) return;

      if (container.getBoundingClientRect().width === 0) return;

      clearDividers(cards);

      var rows = groupIntoRows(cards);
      var totalRows = rows.length;

      rows.forEach(function (row, rowIndex) {
        var isLastRow = rowIndex === totalRows - 1;
        row.forEach(function (card, colIndex) {
          if (colIndex > 0) {
            card.style.borderLeft = border;
          }
          if (!isLastRow) {
            card.style.borderBottom = border;
          }
        });
      });
    }

    function applyAll() {
      var containers = document.querySelectorAll(containerSelector);
      containers.forEach(function (container) {
        applyDividers(container);
      });
    }

    function setup() {
      applyAll();

      if (window.ResizeObserver) {
        var ro = new ResizeObserver(function () {
          applyAll();
        });

          clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
          resizeTimer = setTimeout(applyAll, 100);

      }

        var mo = new MutationObserver(function (mutations) {
          var needsUpdate = mutations.some(function (m) {
            return m.type === 'childList' && m.addedNodes.length;
          });
          if (needsUpdate) applyAll();
        });
        mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      }
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        requestAnimationFrame(function () {
          requestAnimationFrame(setup);
        });
      });

      });

/*!
* Convert footer links to dropdown on mobile
*
* Added by:      @s.n
* Location:      Footer Template > Page Settings > Custom Code
**/
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const mq = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 991px)');

        document.querySelectorAll('.footer-col__head').forEach(function (head) {
            head.addEventListener('click', function () {
                if (!mq.matches) return;
                const col = head.closest('.footer-col');
                const isOpen = col.classList.contains('is-open');

                document.querySelectorAll('.footer-col.is-open').forEach(function (c) {
                    c.classList.remove('is-open');
                });
                if (!isOpen) col.classList.add('is-open');
            });
        });


        mq.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
            if (!e.matches) {
                document.querySelectorAll('.footer-col.is-open').forEach(function (c) {
                    c.classList.remove('is-open');
                });
            }
        });
    });
</script>

  * Targets direct children — no class or tag needed on them.
  *
  * Usage (zero-config):
  *   initCardDividers();
  *
  * Custom options:
  *   initCardDividers('.divide', { color: '#e2e8f0', width: '2px', style: 'dashed' });
  *
  * @param {string} containerSelector  default: '.divide'
  * @param {object} options
  *   color   — default: 'var(--border-general)'
  *   width   — default: '1px'
  *   style   — default: 'solid'
  * 
  * Added by:      @s.n
  * Location:      Bricks > Settings > Custom Code
 **/
  function initCardDividers(containerSelector, options) {
    if (typeof containerSelector === 'object') {
      options = containerSelector;
      containerSelector = '.divide';
    }
    containerSelector = containerSelector || '.divide';
    options = options || {};

    var color = options.color || 'var(--border-general)';
    var width = options.width || '1px';
    var bStyle = options.style || 'solid';
    var border = width + ' ' + bStyle + ' ' + color;

    function getCards(container) {
      return Array.prototype.slice.call(container.children).filter(function (c) {
        return window.getComputedStyle(c).display !== 'none';
      });
    }

    function clearDividers(cards) {
      cards.forEach(function (card) {
        card.style.borderLeft = '';
        card.style.borderBottom = '';
      });
    }

    function groupIntoRows(cards) {
      var rows = [];
      var currentRow = [];
      var currentTop = null;

      cards.forEach(function (card) {
        var top = card.getBoundingClientRect().top;
        if (currentTop === null || Math.abs(top - currentTop) > 2) {
          if (currentRow.length) rows.push(currentRow);
          currentRow = [card];
          currentTop = top;
        } else {
          currentRow.push(card);
        }
      });
      if (currentRow.length) rows.push(currentRow);
      return rows;
    }

    function applyDividers(container) {
      var cards = getCards(container);
      if (!cards.length) return;

      if (container.getBoundingClientRect().width === 0) return;

      clearDividers(cards);

      var rows = groupIntoRows(cards);
      var totalRows = rows.length;

      rows.forEach(function (row, rowIndex) {
        var isLastRow = rowIndex === totalRows - 1;
        row.forEach(function (card, colIndex) {
          if (colIndex > 0) {
            card.style.borderLeft = border;
          }
          if (!isLastRow) {
            card.style.borderBottom = border;
          }
        });
      });
    }

    function applyAll() {
      var containers = document.querySelectorAll(containerSelector);
      containers.forEach(function (container) {
        applyDividers(container);
      });
    }

    function setup() {
      applyAll();

      if (window.ResizeObserver) {
        var ro = new ResizeObserver(function () {
          applyAll();
        });
        document.querySelectorAll(containerSelector).forEach(function (container) {
          ro.observe(container);
        });
      } else {

        var resizeTimer;
        window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
          clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
          resizeTimer = setTimeout(applyAll, 100);
        });
      }

      if (window.MutationObserver) {
        var mo = new MutationObserver(function (mutations) {
          var needsUpdate = mutations.some(function (m) {
            return m.type === 'childList' && m.addedNodes.length;
          });
          if (needsUpdate) applyAll();
        });
        mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      }
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        requestAnimationFrame(function () {
          requestAnimationFrame(setup);
        });
      });
    } else {
      requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        requestAnimationFrame(setup);
      });
    }
  }

  initCardDividers();
</script>

**/
  const header = document.querySelector('#brx-header');

/*!
* Convert footer links to dropdown on mobile
*
* Added by:      @s.n
* Location:      Footer Template > Page Settings > Custom Code
**/
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const mq = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 991px)');

        document.querySelectorAll('.footer-col__head').forEach(function (head) {
            head.addEventListener('click', function () {
                if (!mq.matches) return;
                const col = head.closest('.footer-col');
                const isOpen = col.classList.contains('is-open');

                document.querySelectorAll('.footer-col.is-open').forEach(function (c) {
                    c.classList.remove('is-open');
                });
                if (!isOpen) col.classList.add('is-open');
            });
        });


        mq.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
            if (!e.matches) {
                document.querySelectorAll('.footer-col.is-open').forEach(function (c) {
                    c.classList.remove('is-open');
                });
            }
        });
    });
</script>

 *
 * Added by:      @s.n
 * Location:      "Core features" section > Slot > Code Block > JS

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const accordion = document.querySelector("#brxe-rdflqx");

  if (!accordion) return;

  const items = accordion.querySelectorAll(".brxe-sncojn");
  const titles = accordion.querySelectorAll(".accordion-title-wrapper");

  const DURATION = 8000;
  const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");

  let currentIndex = [...items].findIndex((item) =>
    item.classList.contains("brx-open")
  );

  if (currentIndex === -1) currentIndex = 0;

  let interval = null;
  let isPaused = false;
  let isVisible = true;

  items.forEach((item) => {
    item.style.position = "relative";

    const progress = document.createElement("div");
    progress.classList.add("accordion-progress");

    progress.style.cssText = `
      position:absolute;
      left:0;
      bottom:-1px;
      height:2px;
      width:0%;
      background:#384CE3;
      transition:none;
      z-index:5;
    `;

    item.appendChild(progress);
  });

  function resetProgressBars() {
    items.forEach((item) => {
      const progress = item.querySelector(".accordion-progress");
      progress.style.transition = "none";
      progress.style.width = "0%";
    });
  }

  function animateProgress(index) {
    const progress = items[index].querySelector(".accordion-progress");

    progress.style.transition = "none";
    progress.style.width = "0%";

    progress.offsetWidth;

    progress.style.transition = `width ${DURATION}ms linear`;
    progress.style.width = "100%";
  }

  function openItem(index) {
    if (!items[index].classList.contains("brx-open")) {
      titles[index].click();
    }

    currentIndex = index;

    resetProgressBars();

    if (!isPaused && isVisible && !reduceMotion.matches) {
      animateProgress(index);
    }
  }

  function stopAutoRotate() {
    clearInterval(interval);
    interval = null;

    items.forEach((item) => {
      const progress = item.querySelector(".accordion-progress");
      const computedWidth = getComputedStyle(progress).width;

      progress.style.transition = "none";
      progress.style.width = computedWidth;
    });
  }

  function startAutoRotate() {
    if (reduceMotion.matches || isPaused || !isVisible) return;

    clearInterval(interval);

    resetProgressBars();
    animateProgress(currentIndex);

    interval = setInterval(() => {
      let nextIndex = currentIndex + 1;

      if (nextIndex >= items.length) {
        nextIndex = 0;
      }

      openItem(nextIndex);
    }, DURATION);
  }

  titles.forEach((title, index) => {
    title.addEventListener("click", () => {
      currentIndex = index;

      if (!reduceMotion.matches) {
        startAutoRotate();
      }
    });
  });

  accordion.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
    isPaused = true;
    stopAutoRotate();
  });

  accordion.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
    isPaused = false;
    startAutoRotate();
  });

  accordion.addEventListener("focusin", () => {
    isPaused = true;
    stopAutoRotate();
  });

  accordion.addEventListener("focusout", () => {
    isPaused = false;
    startAutoRotate();
  });

  const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
    ([entry]) => {
      isVisible = entry.isIntersecting;

      if (isVisible) {
        startAutoRotate();
      } else {
        stopAutoRotate();
      }
    },
    {
      threshold: 0.1,
    }

      stopAutoRotate();
      resetProgressBars();
    } else if (isVisible && !isPaused) {
      startAutoRotate();
    }
  }

  if (reduceMotion.addEventListener) {
    reduceMotion.addEventListener("change", handleReducedMotion);
  } else {
    reduceMotion.addListener(handleReducedMotion);
  }

  if (!reduceMotion.matches) {
    startAutoRotate();
  }

/*
  * Adds responsive border dividers to .divide grid containers.
  * Targets direct children — no class or tag needed on them.
  *
  * Usage (zero-config):
  *   initCardDividers();
  *
  * Custom options:
  *   initCardDividers('.divide', { color: '#e2e8f0', width: '2px', style: 'dashed' });
  *
  * @param {string} containerSelector  default: '.divide'
  * @param {object} options
  *   color   — default: 'var(--border-general)'
  *   width   — default: '1px'
  *   style   — default: 'solid'
  * 
  * Added by:      @s.n
  * Location:      Bricks > Settings > Custom Code
 **/
  function initCardDividers(containerSelector, options) {
    if (typeof containerSelector === 'object') {
      options = containerSelector;
      containerSelector = '.divide';
    }
    containerSelector = containerSelector || '.divide';
    options = options || {};

    var color = options.color || 'var(--border-general)';
    var width = options.width || '1px';
    var bStyle = options.style || 'solid';
    var border = width + ' ' + bStyle + ' ' + color;

    function getCards(container) {
      return Array.prototype.slice.call(container.children).filter(function (c) {
        return window.getComputedStyle(c).display !== 'none';
      });
    }

    function clearDividers(cards) {
      cards.forEach(function (card) {
        card.style.borderLeft = '';
        card.style.borderBottom = '';
      });
    }

    function groupIntoRows(cards) {
      var rows = [];
      var currentRow = [];
      var currentTop = null;

      cards.forEach(function (card) {
        var top = card.getBoundingClientRect().top;
        if (currentTop === null || Math.abs(top - currentTop) > 2) {
          if (currentRow.length) rows.push(currentRow);
          currentRow = [card];
          currentTop = top;
        } else {
          currentRow.push(card);
        }
      });
      if (currentRow.length) rows.push(currentRow);
      return rows;
    }

    function applyDividers(container) {
      var cards = getCards(container);
      if (!cards.length) return;

      if (container.getBoundingClientRect().width === 0) return;

      clearDividers(cards);

      var rows = groupIntoRows(cards);
      var totalRows = rows.length;

      rows.forEach(function (row, rowIndex) {
        var isLastRow = rowIndex === totalRows - 1;
        row.forEach(function (card, colIndex) {
          if (colIndex > 0) {
            card.style.borderLeft = border;
          }
          if (!isLastRow) {
            card.style.borderBottom = border;
          }
        });
      });
    }

    function applyAll() {
      var containers = document.querySelectorAll(containerSelector);
      containers.forEach(function (container) {
        applyDividers(container);
      });
    }

    function setup() {
      applyAll();

      if (window.ResizeObserver) {
        var ro = new ResizeObserver(function () {
          applyAll();
        });
        document.querySelectorAll(containerSelector).forEach(function (container) {
          ro.observe(container);
        });
      } else {

        var resizeTimer;
        window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
          clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
          resizeTimer = setTimeout(applyAll, 100);
        });
      }

      if (window.MutationObserver) {
        var mo = new MutationObserver(function (mutations) {
          var needsUpdate = mutations.some(function (m) {
            return m.type === 'childList' && m.addedNodes.length;
          });
          if (needsUpdate) applyAll();
        });
        mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      }
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        requestAnimationFrame(function () {
          requestAnimationFrame(setup);
        });
      });
    } else {
      requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        requestAnimationFrame(setup);
      });
    }
  }

  initCardDividers();
</script>

**/
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const mq = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 991px)');

        document.querySelectorAll('.footer-col__head').forEach(function (head) {
            head.addEventListener('click', function () {
                if (!mq.matches) return;
                const col = head.closest('.footer-col');
                const isOpen = col.classList.contains('is-open');

                document.querySelectorAll('.footer-col.is-open').forEach(function (c) {
                    c.classList.remove('is-open');
                });
                if (!isOpen) col.classList.add('is-open');
            });
        });


        mq.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
            if (!e.matches) {
                document.querySelectorAll('.footer-col.is-open').forEach(function (c) {
                    c.classList.remove('is-open');
                });
            }
        });
    });

/*
  * Adds responsive border dividers to .divide grid containers.
  * Targets direct children — no class or tag needed on them.
  *
  * Usage (zero-config):
  *   initCardDividers();
  *
  * Custom options:
  *   initCardDividers('.divide', { color: '#e2e8f0', width: '2px', style: 'dashed' });
  *
  * @param {string} containerSelector  default: '.divide'
  * @param {object} options
  *   color   — default: 'var(--border-general)'
  *   width   — default: '1px'
  *   style   — default: 'solid'
  * 
  * Added by:      @s.n
  * Location:      Bricks > Settings > Custom Code
 **/
  function initCardDividers(containerSelector, options) {
    if (typeof containerSelector === 'object') {
      options = containerSelector;
      containerSelector = '.divide';
    }
    containerSelector = containerSelector || '.divide';
    options = options || {};

    var color = options.color || 'var(--border-general)';
    var width = options.width || '1px';
    var bStyle = options.style || 'solid';
    var border = width + ' ' + bStyle + ' ' + color;

    function getCards(container) {
      return Array.prototype.slice.call(container.children).filter(function (c) {
        return window.getComputedStyle(c).display !== 'none';
      });
    }

    function clearDividers(cards) {
      cards.forEach(function (card) {
        card.style.borderLeft = '';
        card.style.borderBottom = '';
      });
    }

    function groupIntoRows(cards) {
      var rows = [];
      var currentRow = [];
      var currentTop = null;

      cards.forEach(function (card) {
        var top = card.getBoundingClientRect().top;
        if (currentTop === null || Math.abs(top - currentTop) > 2) {
          if (currentRow.length) rows.push(currentRow);
          currentRow = [card];
          currentTop = top;
        } else {
          currentRow.push(card);
        }
      });
      if (currentRow.length) rows.push(currentRow);
      return rows;
    }

    function applyDividers(container) {
      var cards = getCards(container);
      if (!cards.length) return;

      if (container.getBoundingClientRect().width === 0) return;

      clearDividers(cards);

      var rows = groupIntoRows(cards);
      var totalRows = rows.length;

      rows.forEach(function (row, rowIndex) {
        var isLastRow = rowIndex === totalRows - 1;
        row.forEach(function (card, colIndex) {
          if (colIndex > 0) {
            card.style.borderLeft = border;
          }
          if (!isLastRow) {
            card.style.borderBottom = border;
          }
        });
      });
    }

    function applyAll() {
      var containers = document.querySelectorAll(containerSelector);
      containers.forEach(function (container) {
        applyDividers(container);
      });
    }

    function setup() {
      applyAll();

      if (window.ResizeObserver) {
        var ro = new ResizeObserver(function () {
          applyAll();
        });

*

* Location:      Footer Template > Page Settings > Custom Code
**/
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const mq = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 991px)');

        document.querySelectorAll('.footer-col__head').forEach(function (head) {
            head.addEventListener('click', function () {
                if (!mq.matches) return;
                const col = head.closest('.footer-col');
                const isOpen = col.classList.contains('is-open');

                document.querySelectorAll('.footer-col.is-open').forEach(function (c) {
                    c.classList.remove('is-open');
                });
                if (!isOpen) col.classList.add('is-open');
            });
        });


        mq.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
            if (!e.matches) {
                document.querySelectorAll('.footer-col.is-open').forEach(function (c) {
                    c.classList.remove('is-open');
                });
            }
        });
    });

  * Targets direct children — no class or tag needed on them.
  *
  * Usage (zero-config):
  *   initCardDividers();
  *
  * Custom options:
  *   initCardDividers('.divide', { color: '#e2e8f0', width: '2px', style: 'dashed' });
  *
  * @param {string} containerSelector  default: '.divide'
  * @param {object} options
  *   color   — default: 'var(--border-general)'
  *   width   — default: '1px'
  *   style   — default: 'solid'
  * 
  * Added by:      @s.n
  * Location:      Bricks > Settings > Custom Code
 **/
  function initCardDividers(containerSelector, options) {
    if (typeof containerSelector === 'object') {
      options = containerSelector;
      containerSelector = '.divide';
    }
    containerSelector = containerSelector || '.divide';
    options = options || {};

    var color = options.color || 'var(--border-general)';
    var width = options.width || '1px';
    var bStyle = options.style || 'solid';
    var border = width + ' ' + bStyle + ' ' + color;

    function getCards(container) {
      return Array.prototype.slice.call(container.children).filter(function (c) {
        return window.getComputedStyle(c).display !== 'none';
      });
    }

    function clearDividers(cards) {
      cards.forEach(function (card) {
        card.style.borderLeft = '';
        card.style.borderBottom = '';
      });
    }

    function groupIntoRows(cards) {
      var rows = [];
      var currentRow = [];
      var currentTop = null;

      cards.forEach(function (card) {
        var top = card.getBoundingClientRect().top;
        if (currentTop === null || Math.abs(top - currentTop) > 2) {
          if (currentRow.length) rows.push(currentRow);
          currentRow = [card];
          currentTop = top;
        } else {
          currentRow.push(card);
        }
      });
      if (currentRow.length) rows.push(currentRow);
      return rows;
    }

    function applyDividers(container) {
      var cards = getCards(container);
      if (!cards.length) return;

      if (container.getBoundingClientRect().width === 0) return;

      clearDividers(cards);

      var rows = groupIntoRows(cards);
      var totalRows = rows.length;

      rows.forEach(function (row, rowIndex) {
        var isLastRow = rowIndex === totalRows - 1;
        row.forEach(function (card, colIndex) {
          if (colIndex > 0) {
            card.style.borderLeft = border;
          }
          if (!isLastRow) {
            card.style.borderBottom = border;
          }
        });
      });
    }

    function applyAll() {
      var containers = document.querySelectorAll(containerSelector);
      containers.forEach(function (container) {
        applyDividers(container);
      });
    }

    function setup() {
      applyAll();

      if (window.ResizeObserver) {
        var ro = new ResizeObserver(function () {
          applyAll();
        });
        document.querySelectorAll(containerSelector).forEach(function (container) {
          ro.observe(container);
        });
      } else {

        var resizeTimer;
        window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
          clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
          resizeTimer = setTimeout(applyAll, 100);
        });
      }

      if (window.MutationObserver) {
        var mo = new MutationObserver(function (mutations) {
          var needsUpdate = mutations.some(function (m) {
            return m.type === 'childList' && m.addedNodes.length;
          });
          if (needsUpdate) applyAll();
        });
        mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      }
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        requestAnimationFrame(function () {
          requestAnimationFrame(setup);
        });
      });
    } else {
      requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        requestAnimationFrame(setup);
      });
    }
  }

  initCardDividers();
</script>

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const mq = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 991px)');

                if (!mq.matches) return;
                const col = head.closest('.footer-col');

                document.querySelectorAll('.footer-col.is-open').forEach(function (c) {
                    c.classList.remove('is-open');
